authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-126 platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader-closure design contract: the allowlist taxonomy, the identity/version rule shape, the declared-vs-ambient split, retained loader-trace requirement, and the negative-test classes. It applies nothing, does not populate per-OS package tables, does not re-own DR-G07 extraction, does not re-decide D-006 numbers, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-126 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-126 a T2-02 candidate that locks the qualitative TCB shape D-006 left to this row, and reserves populated OS tables as G22 evidence.

registerRowQuoted.rowVerbatim: | DR-126 | Platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader closure | Security + release + platform owners | [Exact-byte delivery](04-lifecycle-delivery-and-operations.md#exact-byte-delivery) | Closed OS ABI/loader/libc/framework/cert/font/ICU-class allowlist and identity rules; retained loader traces; undeclared-system-resolution negative tests | OPEN | Hard blocker for platform qualification |

tcbTextCarriedVerbatim.surroundingLaw: The full Exact-byte delivery section is L141-166. This row owns the last paragraph (TCB). Extraction/symlink/TOCTOU/spawn-binding remain DR-G07 / DR-103.
linesVerbatim: The signed closure also declares the platform base/host-ABI TCB. A closed
allowlist and identity/version rule covers every permitted OS ABI, loader, libc,
framework, certificate store, font, ICU, and comparable system-class dependency.
Loader traces are retained at qualification. Undeclared library/framework/tool
resolution, alternate loader search, or identity drift refuses; hostile clean
machines prove no ambient system dependency can enter silently.

governingSources.role: INHERITED v1-era pin. Named properties only: D-006 qualitative TCB is this row; numbers are G02; D-002 slice platforms. Live digest at reMeasurementAtV6.

identityRuleShape.declared: Every permitted member appears in the signed closure TCB inventory as exactly the four-field signedEntry { platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence, originSearchPolicy }. That shape is exhaustive. A three-field form is not a conforming signed entry.

identityEvidence.form: See identityEvidenceUnion. Every signed entry carries exactly one tag from the classMap for its class.

identityRuleShape.sameMeans: Two runtime objects are the same member iff platformProfileKey, class, and identityEvidence compare equal under the class-specific rule.
identityRuleShape.drift: Any runtime resolution whose identityEvidence is not an exact allowlist match.
identityRuleShape.populatedTables: Per-OS concrete members are RESERVED as G22 qualification evidence.

loaderTraces.rule: Loader traces are retained at qualification. Absence of a retained trace is a failed qualification.
observationBoundary: every actual resolution or system-class access attempt by the initial image, late loads, descendants, and helper tools, whether or not the object was declared in the signed TCB
descendants and helper tools the core spawns
non-loader system-class accesses (cert/font/ICU-class) covered by the taxonomy
loaderTraces.completenessProof: A trace is complete iff the trusted capture protocol reports sensor-health OK and lifecycle closure, and every actual attempt in the observation boundary is present as an event or an independently checkable inapplicability proof. Self-assertion by an incomplete recorder is not completeness. Partial traces fail. There is no harness-capability escape.

captureProtocol.sensor: A trusted capture source independent of the process under test. The recorder MUST NOT declare its own output complete.
captureProtocol.closureProbes: process-tree enumeration and lifecycle closure markers (start, last-descendant-exit, sensor-health) that can reveal an omitted event
captureProtocol.inapplicabilityProof: An explicit independently checkable proof object naming the class, the reason the class cannot occur on this profile, the probe that would have observed it if it could, and the signed carrier digest. A missing probe is not a proof.

loaderTraces.evidenceJoin: Every observed event MUST match the signed active-profile table or fail. A false allowlistMatch with used outcome is a failed successor.

negativeTests.name: undeclared resolution
negativeTests.passProperty: An undeclared object on the active complete profile refuses. Required for every profile × every taxonomy class, or an explicit proof that the class is absent/inapplicable. Inability to observe or substitute is a qualification failure or platform-removal path, not a skipped cell.

negativeTests.name: alternate loader search
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object found only outside originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder refuses.

negativeTests.name: identity drift
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object whose tagged identityEvidence does not match refuses.

negativeTests.name: hostile clean machine
negativeTests.passProperty: On a clean machine with ambient substitutes present, no undeclared system dependency enters.

g22.testMatrix: every complete platformProfile × every taxonomy class × NT-TCB-1..4, or explicit absent/inapplicable proof. No "that the harness can substitute" quantifier.

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not SATISFY DR-126 until independently reviewed and recorded by a later D-000 MF-6.
Does not populate per-OS allowlist rows.
Does not re-own archive extraction / symlink / TOCTOU (DR-G07).
Does not re-decide D-006 size numbers.
Does not put language-runtime/Node into the core TCB (those are DR-119 component closures).

selectorGrammar.noOrJoin: A member value MUST NOT be an or-join of alternatives. Distinct filesystems and distinct OS version/build selectors are distinct profiles once populated.
selectorGrammar.beforeAllowlistFreeze: Every required member MUST be populated. Partial preview identity is osFamily+architecture only and cannot freeze an allowlist.

supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.form: closed tagged union owned by this contract

macos-product-build.observation: macOS product-build string as Apple publishes it, after Unicode NFC and trim of leading/trailing ASCII whitespace

linux-distro-userspace.observation: closed publisher/distribution identifier plus userspace-release (or equivalent PLATFORM-ATTESTED platform-image identity). uname -r alone is not a complete Linux host-ABI profile key.

EXACT-BUILD.equality: same identifierScheme and byte-exact canonicalIdentifier after normalization

CLOSED-RANGE.standing: PROHIBITED as a required-member value until this contract versions a total order per identifierScheme. A CLOSED-RANGE object cannot occupy supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.

supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.serialization: exactly one lawful tag object. The later packet chooses values inside this language and MUST NOT mint range or scheme semantics.
supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.unrecognizedTagOrWildcard: refuses; cannot occupy a required member
supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.schemeBinding: An EXACT-BUILD identifierScheme MUST match the profile osFamily. macos-product-build is lawful only for osFamily=macos. linux-distro-userspace is lawful only for osFamily=linux.

filesystemWhereItAffectsResolution.form: closed tagged identifier owned by this contract

otherTag.lawfulOnlyWhen: the platform-reported filesystem type is absent from identifierEnum
otherTag.tokenSource: the filesystem-type string as the platform's named statfs/f_fstypename (or equivalent) interface publishes it
otherTag.normalization: Unicode NFC, ASCII case-fold, trim leading/trailing ASCII whitespace
otherTag.digestEncoding: 64 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 encoding of the normalized token

filesystemWhereItAffectsResolution.equality: enum members compare byte-exact; OTHER-FSTYPE compares algorithmId plus digest

platformProfile.relationToEveryTcbEntry: Every TCB allowlist entry is keyed by a complete platformProfile (all four members). An entry keyed only by osFamily+architecture is a failed successor of a frozen allowlist.
platformProfile.populationPacket: A later packet that supplies these selectors is a different artifact. Standing remains RESERVED. requiredBeforeAllowlistFreeze remains true. This contract authors the grammar, including version/build and filesystem selectors, and does not populate them. This row does not name, designate, or claim independent review of that later packet. Choosing its owner is a separate decision. Windows remains D-002 absent.
platformProfile.memberPopulation: Per-OS concrete TCB members remain RESERVED as G22 evidence on a complete profile.

order: Select the active complete (not stem-only) qualified platformProfile.
Observe the actual object and the resolution route.
Allow only an exact allowlist match under identityEvidenceUnion AND originSearchPolicy.
Every other source or route is ambient/alternate and MUST refuse.
resolutionPredicate.g22VersusQualified: G22 exercises a frozen candidate profile. Only a passing G22 result makes the profile qualified. A stem-only profile cannot enter G22.
resolutionPredicate.declaredVersusAmbient: Declared = complete-profile allowlist entry + originSearchPolicy. Ambient = any other object or route.

tcbCarrier.authoritativeInventoryCarrier: The published signed-closure inventory. Exactly one copy.
tcbCarrier.inventoryFieldAuthor: The DR-101 successor (distribution-core-inventory-contract lineage) authors the inventorySchema TCB / layer-table field. DR-103 consumes that field in fixture/schema work and does not author a second carrier.
tcbCarrier.bindingPoint: inventorySchema TCB members keyed by complete platformProfile. The field does not exist until that one DR-101 successor authors it.
tcbCarrier.signatureCeremonyOwner: OD-101-2 ceremony independently; adjacent DR-112 signed-index mechanics. Not this row. Not a slash-joined owner of the inventory field.
tcbCarrier.dependencyIfCarrierAbsent: G22 cannot QUALIFY until that one signed carrier exists and is bound. A population packet is not a substitute carrier.

basedOn.method: v6 is v5 with targeted repairs of Claude CLAUDE-V5-B1/S1/S2 and Codex PTCB-V5-B1/S1. Closed roster: /artifact, /version, /date, /basedOn, /appliesFindingsOf, /honestyRepairsFromV5, /platformProfile/selectorGrammar, /identityEvidenceUnion, /recordedInputs/governingSources (live-locator prose), /reviewGuidance (append), /reMeasurementAtV6. /date is on this roster. Every path neither the roster nor succession metadata names is unchanged from v5.

appliesFindingsOf.idCollisionNote: Claude v5 used B-1/S-1/S-2 (qualify CLAUDE-V5-*). Codex v5 used PTCB-V5-B1/S1.
notFoldedThisSuccessor: CLAUDE-V5-ADV-1/ADV-2 booked if any residue remains after scheme binding.

honestyRepairsFromV1: CODEX-V1-B1: platformProfile key and prequalification authorship boundary.
CODEX-V1-B2: class-appropriate identityEvidence; unconstrained version-or-digest is not sufficient.
CODEX-V1-B3: ordered resolutionPredicate; declared vs ambient defined.
CODEX-V1-B4: observationBoundary + evidenceJoin; NT pass properties; G22 matrix.
CODEX-V1-S1: tcbCarrier names DR-101/DR-103 as inventory carrier; identity policy stays here.

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.requires: verification of the actual resolved object through a trusted platform attestation (codesign, package db, or equivalent). Unconstrained version strings are not this tag.

DIGEST-BOUND.requires: named collision-resistant digest algorithm identifier plus a canonical collection membership/root rule over the observed bytes.

SONAME-ABI.encoding: named optional field sonameAbi: { soname, abiSelector } inside a PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND libc payload

identityEvidenceUnion.comparison: The harness compares the observed resolved object to the tagged authenticity evidence. Selector exactness is EXACT-BUILD under identifierSchemes. CLOSED-RANGE is prohibited. Filesystem other-types use OTHER-FSTYPE. SONAME-ABI may exist only as an optional companion inside a libc PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND payload; it is not a signed-entry field and never sole authenticity.

originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin: Declared install/search origin for this member.
originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder: Closed ordered list of lookup steps. Anything outside the list is alternate and refuses.

environmentInfluence.entries: Each named variable maps to exactly one of { standing: FIXED, expectedValue: <canonical string> } or { standing: FORBIDDEN }. Unnamed variables have standing FORBIDDEN.
environmentInfluence.pathAndLoaderDefault: PATH and loader-config substitution variables (LD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH, LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, and class-equivalent loader substitution variables) are FORBIDDEN unless the signed entry lists the variable with standing FIXED and a concrete expectedValue. Naming the variable without a fixed value does not make substitution lawful.
environmentInfluence.lookupBinding: Every allowed lookup step in allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder is bound to immutable platformProfile plus signed-entry evidence. A step whose inputs include a FORBIDDEN or unnamed variable refuses.

originSearchPolicy.classAppropriateLookup: Class-specific tool/data lookup rule, or null if the class has none.

honestyRepairsFromV2: CODEX-V2-B1: selectorGrammar requires all four members; or-joins forbidden; version/filesystem reserved to population packet; slice1 stems cannot freeze an allowlist.
CODEX-V2-B2: identityEvidenceUnion tagged forms + classMap; comparison is of the resolved object.
CODEX-V2-B3: signedEntry.originSearchPolicy is a required field; NT-TCB-2 tests it.
CODEX-V2-B4: harness-capability quantifier removed; completenessProof defined; inability to observe fails qualification.
CODEX-V2-S1: one carrier (DR-101/103 inventory) and one binding point; ceremony routed to OD-101-2/DR-112.
honestyRepairsFromV3: PTCB-V3-B1: selectorGrammar now owns EXACT-BUILD and CLOSED-RANGE version/build selectors and a canonical filesystem identifier language. The population packet may not mint range semantics.
PTCB-V3-B2: libc authenticity is PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND. SONAME-ABI is an additional compatibility selector only.
PTCB-V3-B3: the declared signed shape is the exhaustive four-field signedEntry. Environment influence is a closed FIXED/FORBIDDEN map; PATH/loader substitution is forbidden by default.

PTCB-V3-B4: observation boundary is every actual attempt; trusted capture plus closure probes; retained schema binds subject/profile/carrier/run/process/class/outcome; evidenceJoin restored; inapplicability proofs independently checkable.
PTCB-V3-S1: one DR-101 successor authors the inventory field; ceremony is independent; G22 cannot QUALIFY while the carrier is absent.
PTCB-V3-S2: /reMeasurementAtV4 is on the closed roster.
CLAUDE-V3-B1: population packet is an indefinite later different artifact. ownerArtifact and 'named independently reviewed' predicates removed. Reservation and freeze precondition remain.
CLAUDE-V3-S1: identityRuleShape.declared is the exhaustive four-field signedEntry (already the v4 Codex B3 repair).
CLAUDE-V3-ADV-1: evidenceJoin restored. CLAUDE-V3-ADV-4: G22 cannot QUALIFY while the carrier is absent.
honestyRepairsFromV4: PTCB-V4-B1: EXACT-BUILD requires an identifierScheme from this contract's closed map; CLOSED-RANGE is prohibited until a versioned total order exists; filesystem escape is OTHER-FSTYPE with sha-256 and 64-hex digest.
PTCB-V4-S1: SONAME-ABI is only an optional companion inside libc authenticity payloads, not a signed-entry field and not sole identity.
CLAUDE-V4-S1: /platformProfile/slice1ProfileStems is on the closed roster (ownerArtifact removals).
CLAUDE-V4-ADV-1: Codex v2 pin rotation is deliberate and named.
honestyRepairsFromV5: CLAUDE-V5-B1: OTHER-FSTYPE has a named token source, NFC+case-fold, enum-absent condition, and serialization.
PTCB-V5-B1: Linux identifierScheme is publisher/distribution plus userspace-release; schemes are osFamily-bound.
CLAUDE-V5-S1 / PTCB-V5-S1: sonameAbi {soname, abiSelector} is an optional field inside libc PLATFORM-ATTESTED and DIGEST-BOUND payloads.
CLAUDE-V5-S2: inherited COORD live locator points at reMeasurementAtV6.
